title: List vaults
summary: List credential vaults and summary counts without exposing secret values. Archived vaults are excluded unless include_archived=true is passed.

parameters.name: include_archived
parameters.description: Optional. Pass true to include archived vaults, which are returned with status "archived" and a non-null archived_at. Omitting it, or passing false, excludes them. Any other value is a 400.

title: Create vault
summary: Create a vault for credentials that can be mounted into sessions.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Human-readable vault name.

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: Opaque tags.

title: Get vault
summary: Fetch a vault descriptor and safe credential summary.

title: Update vault
summary: Patch a vault: display_name (or the local name alias) replaces, description replaces with null clearing, and metadata merges per key (a null or empty-string value deletes the key). An archived vault answers 409 vault_archived.

parameters.name: display_name
parameters.description: New human-readable vault name, 1-255 characters. name is accepted as a local alias; sending both is a 400.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: New description; null clears it.

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: Metadata merge patch; a null or empty-string value deletes the key, omitted keys are preserved.

title: Delete vault
summary: Physically delete a vault and every credential it holds. A non-terminal session referencing it in vault_ids answers 409 vault_in_use; terminal history does not block and an archived vault may be deleted.

title: List credentials
summary: List credentials in a vault. Secret values are always masked or omitted, and each record carries the canonical `display_name` / `auth` projection beside the local fields.

title: Add credential
summary: Add a credential in the canonical nested shape — `display_name` beside `auth` — or in the flat legacy spelling. A body supplying both is refused rather than merged.

parameters.name: auth_type
parameters.description: Credential type and injection mode.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Optional human-readable label.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Secret value. Stored encrypted and never returned in list responses.

parameters.name: network
parameters.description: Allowed hosts and access mode for this credential.

parameters.name: injection_locations
parameters.description: Request header or body injection locations.

response.name: value_hint
response.description: Masked hint for the stored secret.

response.name: auth
response.description: Canonical nested auth object: `type` in `mcp_oauth` | `static_bearer` | `environment_variable`, plus `secret_name` and `injection_location` (`{header, body}`, both resolved) for environment variables or `mcp_server_url` for the MCP-bound types. Write-only fields are absent rather than masked.

response.name: warnings
response.description: Present only when the request asked for something this runtime does not do, such as an OAuth `refresh` block.

title: Archive credential
summary: Archive a credential while retaining audit metadata.

title: Get credential
summary: Retrieve one credential. Secret material is never returned; the response carries value_hint only.

title: Update a credential
summary: Published partial update (mounted at /v1/vaults too). display_name replaces; metadata merges per key with null deleting. auth is a type-discriminated patch: auth.type is immutable and must match the stored credential (static_bearer is the canonical spelling of a stored bearer_token), structural fields (mcp_server_url, secret_name, token_endpoint, client_id) are locked, and token/access_token/secret_value re-encrypt and write a rotate audit event. expires_at and refresh are accepted with a warning rather than persisted.

parameters.name: display_name
parameters.description: Replacement name, 1-255 characters. The local name spelling is an accepted alias; sending both is a 400.

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: Merge patch: a null or empty-string value deletes the key; omitted keys are preserved.

parameters.name: auth
parameters.description: Type-discriminated partial update: environment_variable takes secret_value, injection_location, networking (null clears to unrestricted); static_bearer takes token; mcp_oauth takes access_token plus accepted-but-unpersisted expires_at and refresh.

response.name: data
response.description: The updated credential projection. Secret material is never echoed; value_hint tracks the stored secret.

response.name: warnings
response.description: Present when accepted-but-unpersisted fields (expires_at, refresh) were supplied.

title: Delete credential
summary: Physically delete a credential from a vault. A second delete is a 404; the audit trail survives at vault scope.

title: Archive vault
summary: Archive a credential vault and remove it from active selection.

title: Rotate credential
summary: Replace a credential's encrypted secret value. The credential keeps its identity, policy and audit history, and the previous value is not recoverable from the row afterwards.

parameters.name: vault_id
parameters.description: Credential vault id.

parameters.name: credential_id
parameters.description: Credential id.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: New secret value. An empty or missing value is refused with 400, and the stored secret is left untouched.

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: Optional actor recorded on the rotate audit event.

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: Optional metadata recorded on the rotate audit event. Never contains the secret.

response.name: value_hint
response.description: Masked hint of the new value. The secret itself is never returned.

title: Mark credential used
summary: Stamp a credential as used and append a use event to its audit trail. This is the one management call a client makes without a body.

parameters.name: vault_id
parameters.description: Credential vault id.

parameters.name: credential_id
parameters.description: Credential id.

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: Optional metadata recorded on the use event.

title: List credential audit events
summary: List one credential's rotation, use and runtime injection events newest first. The trail survives deletion and never contains secret material.

parameters.name: vault_id
parameters.description: Credential vault id.

parameters.name: credential_id
parameters.description: Credential id.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum events to return. Defaults to 100 and is capped at 500.

title: List vault audit events
summary: List every credential audit event in one vault newest first, including events for credentials that were deleted afterwards.

parameters.name: vault_id
parameters.description: Credential vault id.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum events to return. Defaults to 100 and is capped at 500.

response.name: data
response.description: Audit events for the vault, newest first.

title: Refuse MCP OAuth validation
summary: MCP OAuth validation is unavailable; this route refuses the capability before reading the body or accessing a credential.

response.name: error
response.description: HTTP 400 unsupported_capability with the mcp-oauth-validation id and a compatibility-table reference.
